ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid fraud investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the Minneapolis man charged with $3M in fraud. It would also explore potential connections to other patterns of abuse and the impact on the state's healthcare system.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How does this relate to other patterns of abuse?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it has significant implications for Minnesota's healthcare system and taxpayers. The investigation should focus on following the money and identifying potential connections to other patterns of abuse.
